messages:
maria: Quick summary — I added a new 'SLO ladder' section to the prefix-cache dashboard. It buckets per-route hit rates into tiers (>90, 75-90, 50-75, <50) and shows token-saved totals per tier. Plotted as a stacked bar + small multiples by model.
ken: Love the tiers. Can we also surface occupancy (cache slots used) per-tenant? that's often the root cause when hit-rate drops but tokens-saved looks ok.
dani: Yep — added an occupancy violin per-tenant at the bottom. Also included a p95 latency overlay so we can see if low hit-rate correlates with latency spikes.
leo: Important: we need to correlate ladder drops with kernel-selection flips and batching heuristic changes. Last week's kernel pin caused a 12% hit-rate drop on route `chat-completion-v2`.
maria: Good call. I wired the dashboard to include a small event strip that shows deploy-bot messages and kernel flag toggles. Example PromQL I used to compute per-route hit-rate:
```
(sum by(route) (prefix_cache_hits_total{env="prod"})
 /
 sum by(route) (prefix_cache_requests_total{env="prod"}))
```
ken: Can you add a delta panel showing 24h change and a changelog of kernel selection per-model? that will help owners triage quickly.
dani: Done. Also added a lightweight table that joins route -> kernel_version -> batching_policy. It pulls from our infra tag store every 5m. If kernel_version changes and hit-rate drops >5% within 30m, the row is flagged.
sre-jen: Suggest an automated alert runbook: if route tier drops from >75 to <50 and token-saved delta is negative, page the runtime-oncall. Otherwise create a ticket in eng-runtime with priority low.
maria: I prototyped a 'regression drill' button on the dashboard that runs these checks and opens a filtered perf trace search for the route + time window.
leo: Also, can we surface the KV-cache warmup gap? a lot of issues are warmstart-related. A simple metric: "kv_warm_keys_ratio" in first 60s of session vs baseline.
ken: +1. We should show warmup curves per-tenant; high-tail customers often have poor warmup and drag global yield numbers down.
maria: I've added warmup sparkline thumbnails. For large tenants we sample 1% of requests and persist their prefix fingerprints for backfill analysis.
ops-bot: scheduled-job: backfill/prefix-hitrate-samples started for window 1768800000-1768888800. Estimated time: 18m.
deploy-bot: deploy: prefix-slo-ladder panels merged to main by @maria — will go live on next dashboard refresh.
dani: Follow-ups: (1) add model-kernel correlation scatter (hit-rate delta vs kernel_version) (2) add sampling tag so we can join traces to queries (3) run a week-long A/B for occupancy-aware batching.
sre-jen: Also recommend adding a 'stable-segment' SLO per-tenant (weekly hit-rate >= 80). That makes contractual expectations clearer for Dedicated customers.
ken: One thing to watch — quantization/kv-layout changes can change fingerprint formation and reduce key matches. We need an annotation panel showing recent model quant or layout changes.
maria: noted. I'll add an annotation stream for model changes (layout, quant, tokenizer updates).
leo: For immediate triage, run this quick SQL to list top 10 routes with hit-rate drop >8% and increased p95:
```
SELECT route, model, old_hitrate, new_hitrate, token_saved_delta
FROM prefix_hitrate_rollup
WHERE new_hitrate < old_hitrate - 0.08
ORDER BY token_saved_delta ASC
LIMIT 10;
```
maria: thanks — ran it and created tickets for the top 3. I'll post updates here once owners investigate.
ken: Nice work. Can we schedule a 30-min sync next Tue to review the first week's telemetry after the dashboard goes live?
dani: calendar invite sent to #eng-runtime and owners.
maria: closing loop — PR link https://git.redwood/infradash/+/2345. If you see odd panels ping me. :rocket:
